interfaces.describe(split): Public task and bounded probe schema; split is train or holdout; no held-out answers.
interfaces.lesson(): General noninterference/execution/handoff lesson JSON, with scope and non-cases.
interfaces.teacher_probes(): Training probes against a source-pinned real local oracle implementation.
interfaces.evaluate(probe, split=...): Fresh local state; returns status, stable violation signature and measurements. No model/API calls.
interfaces.control(probe, split=...): Identical operations and handoff, with diagnostic overrides removed.
interfaces.novelty(probe): Checks a substantively different temporal scenario, not renamed training IDs.
interfaces.verify_student(probe): Host-only fresh holdout replay twice plus paired control; no submitted verdict is trusted.

status_semantics.scope: Correctness of the evaluator's decision, distinct from the simulated workload's success.
status_semantics.violation: The actual frozen oracle disagrees with independently computed execution/handoff invariants.
status_semantics.passed: The oracle correctly accepts or rejects this workload, including negative workload controls.
status_semantics.error: Invalid probe, missing source integrity, unexpected runtime failure; never a discovery.

scope_limits.student_access: Only describe, lesson and bounded probe interface. Do not provide filesystem/source or host evidence containing held-out probes.

source_version: Frozen pre-fix source. The current original plugin has been repaired; student probes deliberately exercise the frozen regression target.
known_scope_limit: Requires a diagnostic metadata collision at the pre-fix judge API. The normal plugin constructed non-colliding metadata and the current judge is now repaired; this was not a demonstrated remote or Nemotron failure.
